summary: Somnigroup International Inc. filed an 8-K reporting completion of its acquisition of Leggett Platt, Incorporated via a merger. Merger Sub merged with and into Leggett Platt, which survived as a wholly owned subsidiary. Each Leggett Platt share was converted into 0.1455 Somnigroup shares, with cash for fractional shares. The S-4 registration was declared effective July 9, 2026. Restricted shares vested and converted; options and RSUs were assumed/adjusted. The deal closed August 26, 2026, after the April 13, 2026 merger agreement. What to watch: post-merger integration, share price performance, and potential dissenting shareholder appraisal actions.
